name: EuroRust 2027
description: European Rust conference, talks, workshops and side events
note: Conference + workshops, hybrid (Prague and online), English; early-bird tickets on sale, price not shown
dateNote: site header says Oct 14-17, body and ticket page say Oct 13-16; conference days Oct 14-15
details: Two-day European Rust community conference (Oct 14-15, 9:00-18:00) with workshops on Oct 13 at a separate city-centre location and side events and hackathons on Oct 13, 14 and 16. Venue per ticket page is Cubex Centrum (postcode 140 00, Prague); street address not given on the page. Subsidized tickets for private attendees and freelancers, company tickets for reimbursed attendees; exact prices not published on the pages read. Also streamed online.
